titles.title: unselected clients are always emitted as skipped, never omitted
{claude:true} registers claude (mcp add --scope user); codex is skipped
{agents:true} maps to the codex client (agents flag → codex, --scope omitted)
{vibe:true} registers vibe via `vibe mcp add insrc --transport stdio`; no `mcp list` is spawned
vibe already present in config.toml [[mcp_servers]] → unchanged, no add spawned
vibe add failure → failed carrying the CLI stderr; other clients unaffected
upsertVibeAgentsSteering: creates AGENTS.md with the marked steering block when absent, idempotent on second call
upsertVibeAgentsSteering: replaces only the marked span on re-registration (future release updates content in place), preserves surrounding user content
upsertVibeAgentsSteering: malformed markers (open without close) are a guarded no-op — file untouched, never clobbered
registerMcpClients with {vibe:true} also upserts the AGENTS.md steering block (in-memory seam), and registration still succeeds
vibeConfigHasServer: matches an [[mcp_servers]] name line only, not other tables or values
an existing `insrc` entry in `mcp list` → unchanged, no add spawned
an `insrc` substring only inside a path (not a line-start name) does NOT count as registered
an indeterminate `mcp list` (non-zero exit) → failed, and deliberately does NOT add
a missing CLI binary (ENOENT spawn) → failed with a not-found note, no throw
a non-zero `mcp add` exit → failed carrying the CLI stderr
per-client isolation: claude add fails, codex still registers independently
mixed idempotency: claude already present, codex absent → unchanged + registered
a missing out/bin/insrc-mcp.js → failed for each selected client, no subprocess
registerMcpClients never rejects even if the injected run throws
probeMcpClients: per-client availability + registration from the same pre-checks registration uses; never throws
probeMcpClients: an unreachable CLI resolves available:false, registered:false; a vibe without config text is registered:false
vibe + repoPath: writes [[mcp_servers]] insrc into the repo's own .vibe/config.toml, never spawns `vibe mcp add`, note says restart vibe
vibe + repoPath: existing project entry → unchanged, nothing written; existing unrelated content is preserved on write
vibe without repoPath keeps the user-global `vibe mcp add` path (unchanged behavior)
probeMcpClients with a repoPath counts the repo's project .vibe/config.toml as registered for vibe
upsertVibeProjectServer on a real temp dir: creates .vibe/config.toml, idempotent, valid entry
upsertVibeProjectServer moves an inline mcp_servers list to tables, keeping its servers
upsertVibeProjectServer removes an empty inline list before adding the server
upsertVibeProjectServer repairs a config holding both forms, and adds no second insrc entry
upsertVibeProjectServer recognises an inline insrc entry with a quoted name key and adds no second one
upsertVibeProjectServer leaves a config it cannot fix untouched and reports the failure
a config with no inline list comes back unchanged
an empty inline list is removed and every other line is kept
an empty list in a file that also has tables under the key is repaired
entries in the form Vibe saves become tables after everything else
commas, brackets and hashes inside strings do not split an entry
only the root-level key is moved
a quoted or escaped spelling of the key is the same key
a comment after the list is kept on its own line
a file ending without a newline after the list is handled
what cannot be moved without loss is refused
registerHostCommands registers the insrc.hosts.wire command into the registry
the wire command asks ONE combined consent (items = detected displayNames) and wires NONE until accepted
on accepted every detected adapter.wire() runs; a failing adapter does not abort the others; the outcome is pushed to sc2
no supported host present → the command sets a "no hosts detected" status and wires nothing
source-scan: vscode-plugin/src/hosts/ imports only node builtins + the s1 surfaces (+ shared local modules) — no daemon internals/indexer/storage, no cloud/HTTP (k5)
writeInsrcServer sets mcpServers.insrc preserving every other key/server; idempotent; creates {} when absent
writeInsrcServer throws HostFileAccessError (no write) when mcpServers is present-but-non-object (never clobber)
removeInsrcServer deletes only the insrc key (other servers intact) and is a no-op when absent
SteeringWriter.upsert: no-markers→append; markers→replace; malformed/duplicate→untouched; idempotent; remove deletes/absent no-op
SteeringWriter.remove deletes the marker block (restoring prior content) and is a no-op when no markers exist
both writers leave the file byte-unchanged when HostFileSystem.write throws (no partial write)
composeMcpEntry(path) = { command:node, args:[path] } and returns undefined for an undefined/empty target (no cloud/env/argv)
toml writeInsrcServer creates the [[mcp_servers]] insrc section in an absent file
toml writeInsrcServer appends to an existing config preserving every other table/key/comment
toml writeInsrcServer replaces an existing insrc section (new args), keeping the header line, and is idempotent
toml writer refuses duplicate insrc sections (never guesses) and leaves the file unchanged
toml removeInsrcServer drops the insrc section and its [mcp_servers.auth] sub-table, preserving everything else; no-op when absent
toml writeInsrcServer removes an empty inline mcp_servers list so the file stays valid; idempotent
toml writeInsrcServer moves inline servers to tables and keeps them
toml writeInsrcServer repairs a file holding both forms without adding a second insrc section
toml writeInsrcServer recognises an inline insrc entry with a quoted name key and adds no second one
toml writeInsrcServer refuses a config it cannot fix and leaves it unchanged
toml writer escapes quotes/backslashes in the launch path (TOML basic string)
toml writer surfaces fs failures as HostFileAccessError with no partial write
